title: MCV–RDW interaction does not reliably improve cross-release prediction of digit-symbol processing speed
abstract: In NHANES adults60+, an MCV×RDW interaction added to demographic,education,hemoglobin and additive-index ridge baselines reduced held-out MSE by 0.611 symbols² in2013–14 (95%PSU-refit interval-2.386 to1.844) and 0.357 in1999–2000 (-1.402 to1.612). Neither confirms the prespecified improvement criterion. Instrument changes,complete-case selection and same-survey validation limit inference;no clinical utility established.
